correctness.rationale: For k=algebraic closure of F13 and u!=0,1, the quartic partials have no common projective zero, so genus 3. In the cohomology basis e1=(2,1,1), e2=(1,2,1), e3=(1,1,2), coefficient extraction [X^{13ej-ei}Y...Z...] F^12 yields diagonal (u^3 B,B,T), B=6u^3+u^2+u+6, T=-6u^3-4u^2-u-1 over F13[u]. My independent exact multinomial enumeration checked all nine matrix entries as polynomials, and for companion K checked H=11I3. Coprime separable B=6(u+1)(u^2-3u+1), T=-6(u+6)(u^2-u+4) have disjoint 3 roots each away from 0,1; quadratic discriminants 5 and 11 nonsquares in F13. Diagonal semilinear Frobenius ensures stable p-rank equals one-step rank, so B roots p-rank1/a2, T roots p-rank2/a1, and all other smooth parameters ordinary. Explicit scope is embedded parameter pencil, not isomorphism classes or all Newton polygons.
